release_name: Monastere du Carmel, source-link fixes, Sainte-Odile
notes: Adds the Carmelite monastery at Bonne-Terre (Vacoas) and fixes source links found by auditing every parish page against the corpus. (1) Monastere du Carmel: 7 rows, 08:00 daily including Sunday, public welcome. It is a contemplative monastery, not a parish, so it is absent from the diocesan Paroisses & Messes listing and no schedule is published anywhere; it is also absent from OpenStreetMap. Coordinates come from the Google Maps place marker on Couvent Lane, cross-checked by reverse geocode (Vacoas-Phoenix, 529 m from the Bonne-Terre centre). Because the time can move when no priest is available it carries a NEW advisory kind rather than the existing one: confirm_not_regular explicitly quotes the diocese and says the Mass is not held regularly, which would have been false twice over here, so time_may_vary was added with honest wording plus a tappable phone number via a new contact_phone field (whitelisted in RUNTIME_FIELDS, without which it would never reach the app). (2) Nine rows across five chapel/convent sites pointed at the generic paroisses-messes index while their own label promised a specific parent parish page; each corrected to a page that returns 200 and that demonstrably names the site. (3) Three Notre-Dame-de-Fatima Triolet rows moved off an orphaned WordPress duplicate URL onto the canonical page linked from the diocese index. (4) Saint-Odile corrected to Sainte-Odile across 12 field values. Centre Chapelle Saint-Esprit deliberately left on the generic index: it has two candidate parents and needs a human decision. Verified: 424 rows, advisory renders in both languages with a working tel: link, the diocese-attributed wording is unchanged for the row that legitimately uses it, and Sunday obligation is set only on the Sunday row.
